cards.0895: At number twelve a woman of seventy-eight has a heap of field stones along the side of the yard and means to put the fingers of one hand up behind the back edge of one standing stone with the palm turned away and the tips curled over it and to find out how far the hand goes behind it and what is at the far end. Nothing lifted nothing dug no joint pointed no room entered.
cards.0896: At number nine a woman in her late fifties has a gate post of timber at the front with three bored holes in the face of it and means to put the tips of two fingers in together and turn them round inside each hole and to find out how deep each goes and what is at the bottom. The post not moved the holes not bored deeper the wedges not moved the spanner not picked the coal not opened.
cards.0897: At the unit a man in his early forties has a bench along the wall of the store with boards on trestles and means to slide the elbow side of the forearm into the low space under it with the hand folded back against it and to find out what the boards rest on and how far in the arm goes. Nothing lifted no bar in the latch hooked the staple NOT DONE April NOT PAGE.
cards.0898: At number ten a woman in her early thirties has two path boards laid along the side of the bed and means to lay the side of the first finger along the slot between them and draw it the length with the nail brushing one side and to find out what is under the slot and how much it gives. Nothing lifted nothing laid the thread not cut the line not put right the tap not touched.
cards.0899: At the lock-up a woman in her late forties has a square hole in the apron with a dish in the bottom of it and means to set the heel of the hand into the mouth of it and push until the wrist meets the rim and to find out how far down the dish lies and what it is. Nothing put in the hole the heap not touched the oval holes not filled or plugged.
cards.0900: At number twelve a woman of seventy-eight has a bed with a face of soil standing a spade deep at the end of the yard and means to spread thumb and fingers round the inside of a hollow in that face and press them outwards to its sides and to find out how far back it goes and what cut it. Nothing dug nothing planted no room entered.
cards.0901: At the lock-up a woman in her late forties has a rack along the wall with two lengths of timber on it and means to push the back of the fingers up under the lip of the lower length with the palm down and the wrist low and to find out what the length sits on. Nothing lifted the shutter stays down the bench not moved the oval holes not filled or plugged.
cards.0902: At number ten a woman in her early thirties has two slabs at the end of the strip with a joint between them and means to put the wrist into the joint sideways with the hand hanging loose past it and the forearm flat against the face of the slab and to find out how deep the joint runs and what lies under it. Neither slab lifted nothing cut the felt and the ply neither touched nor nailed.
cards.0903: At the unit a man in his early forties has a stack of eleven boards against the wall and means to run the little-finger side of the hand down the gap behind the middle board with the thumb held clear off the face and to find out what is behind it and how wide it runs. No board moved no bar in the latch hooked the staple NOT DONE April NOT PAGE.
cards.0904: At number nine a woman in her late fifties has a flag at the foot of the front step standing a hair high at one corner and means to run the knuckles of a closed hand down inside the narrow opening under that corner with the fingers folded and the backs of them leading and to find out what the corner stands on. The flag not lifted the gate not touched the coal not opened.
